shellCommands.command: mkdir -p data && echo '[]' > data/books.json && echo '[]' > books.json && ls -la data/ books.json

PORT=3001 node server.js &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 100
echo "---STATUS---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3001/
echo
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books
echo
# test adding book via api
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Great sci-fi"}' 
echo
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books
cat data/books.json
echo "---DETAIL---"
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "ID=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$ID | head -n 200
echo "---FINISH---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/books/$ID/finish -H "Content-Type: application/json" | cat
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books
cat data/books.json
cat books.json
# kill
kill %1
sleep 1
echo "done"

PORT=3002 node server.js &
sleep 2
# reset
echo '[]' > data/books.json
echo '[]' > books.json
curl -s http://localhost:3002/ | grep -c "Currently Reading"
# test form encoded add
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3002/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=The+Hobbit&author=J.R.R.+Tolkien&notes=Loved+it" -L | head -n 50
curl -s http://localhost:3002/ | grep -A2 "Currently Reading"
curl -s http://localhost:3002/api/books
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3002/api/books | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "ID $ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3002/books/$ID | grep -o "The Hobbit"
# test mark finished via form (urlencoded, with redirect)
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3002/books/$ID/finish -L | head -n 20
curl -s http://localhost:3002/ | grep -A2 "Finished"
curl -s http://localhost:3002/books/$ID | grep -o "Finished"
# test shareable link contains url
curl -s http://localhost:3002/books/$ID | grep -o "http://localhost:.*books"
cat data/books.json
kill %1
sleep 1
# restart persistence test
PORT=3002 node server.js &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3002/api/books | grep -o "Hobbit"
kill %1
wait 2>/dev/null; echo done

echo '[]' > data/books.json; echo '[]' > books.json
PORT=3002 node server.js &
sleep 2
# add via form no json
curl -i -s -X POST http://localhost:3002/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=1984&author=George+Orwell&notes=Dystopia" | head -n 10
curl -s http://localhost:3002/ | grep -o "1984"
# json api still
curl -s http://localhost:3002/api/books | grep -o "1984"
# finish via json
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3002/api/books | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3002/books/$ID/finish -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" | grep -o "finished"
curl -s http://localhost:3002/books/$ID | grep -o "George Orwell"
curl -s http://localhost:3002/books/$ID | grep "Dystopia"
# homepage after finished
curl -s http://localhost:3002/ | grep -A1 "Finished"
cat data/books.json
kill %1
sleep 1
echo done

echo '[]' > data/books.json; echo '[]' > books.json
PORT=3003 node server.js &
sleep 2
echo "=== HOME ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3003/ | grep -E "Currently Reading|Finished|Add a Book" 
echo "=== FORM CHECK ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3003/ | grep -E 'name="title"|name="author"|name="notes"'
echo "=== ADD BOOK VIA FORM ==="
curl -s -c /tmp/cookie -X POST http://localhost:3003/books -d "title=Test+Book&author=Test+Author&notes=My+notes+here" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/out
echo
curl -s http://localhost:3003/ | grep -o "Test Book"
curl -s http://localhost:3003/api/books | cat
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3003/api/books | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "ID $ID"
echo "=== DETAIL PAGE ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3003/books/$ID | grep -E "Test Book|Test Author|My notes here"
echo "=== SHAREABLE LINK CHECK ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3003/books/$ID | grep -o 'href=".*books/[^"]*"' | head -5
echo "=== MARK FINISHED ==="
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3003/books/$ID/finish -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" | grep finished
curl -s http://localhost:3003/ | grep -A2 Finished
curl -s http://localhost:3003/books/$ID | grep -o Finished
echo "=== JSON FILE CHECK ==="
cat data/books.json
cat books.json
kill %1
sleep 1
# restart persistence
PORT=3003 node server.js &
sleep 2
echo "=== AFTER RESTART ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3003/api/books | grep -o "Test Book"
curl -s http://localhost:3003/ | grep -o "Test Book"
kill %1
echo done
ps aux | grep node | grep -v grep; echo '[]' > data/books.json; echo '[]' > books.json; ls -lh data/books.json books.json; cat data/books.json; cat package.json; cat server.js | head -n 5
